# Rakazo [English](./README.md) | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](./README.ja.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/elie222/rakazo?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20the%20community-5865F2?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/RWwKa2Sn7h) [![Download on the App Store](https://img.shields.io/badge/App%20Store-Download%20for%20iPhone-black?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/app/rakazo/id6801531099) [![Get Android on Google Play](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Play-Get%20the%20app-black?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=googleplay&logoColor=white)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rakazo.app) ![Rakazo — AI teammates you actually own](./docs/readme-hero.png) Rakazo is an open source, self-hosted alternative to Grok Bot. Persistent AI teammates with their own memory, routines, apps, and computer. Run it on your own machine, with your own model. Use it on the [web](https://app.rakazo.com), [desktop](https://rakazo.com/download/), [iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/rakazo/id6801531099), and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rakazo.app). It is also an alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots, Instinct, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and Claude Duet. Learn more at [rakazo.com](https://rakazo.com). ## Features - Routines - Memory - Computer and browser use - Private or shared team computers - Sandboxes in Docker, the cloud, or on your own machine - Group chats - Delegation and subagents - Builds dashboards and docs you can share by link - Voice chat and calls - Any model, with your own keys - Thousands of app integrations, plus MCP
### Every bot gets a computer A browser, terminal, files, and a full desktop. Watch it work, take control to sign in, and hand it back. ### Bots that work together Put bots in a group and @mention them. They split the work, check each other, and report back.
### Routines Run a bot on a schedule, from an email, or from a webhook, and see every run. ### Pages Bots build live dashboards and documents you can open full screen, share, and ask about.
### Connected apps Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Linear and thousands more, plus your own MCP servers and OpenAPI tools. ### On every device Web, desktop, iPhone, and Android, all talking to the same server.
## Quick start (published images) You need Docker Engine, the Compose plugin, curl, and OpenSSL. No clone or Node install. ```bash mkdir -p rakazo && cd rakazo && curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elie222/rakazo/main/infra/compose/install-images.sh && bash install-images.sh ``` The installer downloads the Compose files, creates `.env` with random secrets, and starts Rakazo. It preserves an existing `.env` when rerun. Open [http://127.0.0.1:5173](http://127.0.0.1:5173), create an account, and connect a model. Local Docker computers are on by default. Optional remote providers: `e2b`, `novita`, `daytona`, `createos`, `boat`, `boxd`, or `railway` with the matching API key. Default image tag is `edge` (main builds, `linux/amd64` + `linux/arm64`). Details and tags: [self-hosting guide](./docs/self-host.md#published-images-no-checkout). On restricted networks, override the installer download base (`RAKAZO_DOWNLOAD_BASE`), skip existing Compose files (`--local` / `RAKAZO_DOWNLOAD_SKIP_EXISTING`), or mirror the bootstrap script URL — see [Restricted networks / mirror downloads](./docs/self-host.md#restricted-networks--mirror-downloads). For an agent-assisted install, use [SETUP_PROMPT.md](./SETUP_PROMPT.md). ## Run on a server Bots stay on when the backend runs on a server. Use the same installer on a VPS, then connect from the desktop app, the mobile app, or a browser. ```bash bash install-images.sh --prepare-only # edit .env: SANDBOX_PROVIDER=boat (or e2b / daytona / createos) with its API key, RAKAZO_HOST=your.domain bash install-images.sh ``` Put HTTPS in front of port 5173; [docs/self-host-production.md](./docs/self-host-production.md#public-single-vm-deployment) covers the Caddy setup and host hardening. In the desktop app choose **Existing instance** and enter the `https://` address. Or [deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/new/template/rakazo-template); see the [Railway setup guide](./infra/railway/README.md). ## Local development (source checkout) You need Node.js 24.15.0 or newer in the 24.x line, or Node.js 26+; pnpm 12; and Docker. Node.js 25.x is not supported. ```bash git clone https://github.com/elie222/rakazo.git cd rakazo cp .env.example .env ``` Set `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` and `POSTGRES_APP_PASSWORD` to two values from `openssl rand -hex 16`, then put them in `DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL` and `DATABASE_URL`. The app connects as its own `rakazo_app` login, which row-level security applies to; migrations run as the owner ([database roles](docs/self-host-configuration.md#database-roles)). Set `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`, `ENCRYPTION_KEY`, and `SCREEN_PROXY_SECRET` to independent long random values. Docker sandboxes also need a dedicated `SANDBOX_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN`. You can also set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, or connect a supported model provider during onboarding. For host-side development with Docker Desktop, set `SANDBOX_CONTROL_VIA_LOOPBACK=true` in `.env`. The supervisor discovers Docker Desktop's user socket automatically; `DOCKER_HOST` or `DOCKER_SOCKET` can override it for another Docker runtime. Managed app catalogs are optional. Set `COMPOSIO_API_KEY` for Composio, or the `PIPEDREAM_CLIENT_ID`, `PIPEDREAM_CLIENT_SECRET`, and `PIPEDREAM_PROJECT_ID` trio for Pipedream Connect. Users can add an HTTPS MCP server or OpenAPI JSON document from **Integrations** without enabling either managed catalog. Connector credentials are encrypted on the server and are never returned by the API. Paid data services (map places, search results, work emails, profiles, SEO data) are optional too. Set `PAID_SERVICES_PROVIDER=treg` and `PAID_SERVICES_API_KEY` to an org-scoped [Treg](https://treg.to) token, and bots can find and call them on the deployment's account. When model credits are on, each call is charged to the organization's credits at the provider's cost plus 20%. ```bash pnpm install pnpm sandbox:build pnpm dev ``` `pnpm dev` uses the Postgres in `DATABASE_URL` when it accepts a connection. Otherwise it starts a local `rakazo-dev-postgres` container with Docker, and every checkout reuses that one. It applies migrations and generates the Prisma client before starting. A branch that adds migrations main doesn't have gets its own database on the same server, copied from the shared one when possible, so unmerged schema changes stay out of it. When the default ports are taken, for example by another git worktree, it moves to the next free block and prints the URL. Set `WEB_PORT` and `API_PORT` to choose ports yourself. To try a checkout from your phone or another computer, install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on each device and set `RAKAZO_DEV_TAILNET=1` in `.env`. `pnpm dev` then serves the web app over HTTPS at `https://..ts.net:`, reachable only from devices on your tailnet, and stops serving it when you quit. Sign in at that URL on every device, including the one running it. The first run may ask you to turn on HTTPS certificates for your tailnet. To keep keys in a secrets manager instead of `.env`, set `RAKAZO_DEV_RUN_WITH` to the command that runs another with your secrets added, for example `op run --env-file=dev.env --` or `infisical run --env=dev --projectId= --`. `pnpm dev` then starts inside it, and the values it adds win over `.env`. To run Postgres from the Compose file instead, start it with the `postgres-host` overlay, which publishes loopback `127.0.0.1:5433`, and point `DATABASE_URL` and `DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL` at it: ```bash docker compose --env-file .env \ -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml \ -f infra/compose/docker-compose.postgres-host.yml \ up postgres -d ``` Use a URI-safe `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` (`openssl rand -hex 16`). An existing `pgdata` volume keeps the user, password, and database from first init, so keep those values in `.env`, or change them in place with `ALTER ROLE` / rename. Recreate the volume only after a backup (or when the data is disposable); `docker compose down -v` deletes all Postgres state. Open the printed URL ([http://127.0.0.1:5173](http://127.0.0.1:5173) by default), create an account, connect a model, and create your first bot. For deployment, provider selection, backups, and upgrades, see the [self-hosting guide](./docs/self-host.md), [production deployment](./docs/self-host-production.md), [backup and restore](./docs/self-host-backups.md), and [upgrading](./docs/self-host-upgrading.md). To use CreateOS, set `SANDBOX_PROVIDER=createos` and `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_API_KEY`. Optional `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_BASE_URL`, `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_SHAPE`, and `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_ROOTFS` default to `https://api.sb.createos.sh`, `s-2vcpu-2gb`, and `desktop:1`. To use Railway computers, set `SANDBOX_PROVIDER=railway`, `RAILWAY_API_TOKEN` and `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID` on the API and worker. Choose the sandbox environment explicitly; Railway's automatic environment ID identifies the hosted app's environment. Use the narrowest Railway API token that works: prefer a project token if sufficient for sandbox operations and supported by the client's authentication. This provider currently uses bearer authentication, so use a team/workspace token rather than a personal account token. The live screen and desktop require `PRIVATE` networking so Railway's public domain can serve the screen. Computers use this mode and can reach other services in the same Railway project/environment, as well as the public internet. We recommend a dedicated Railway project (or at least a separate environment) for sandboxes, separate from the app and database. Recreate existing `ISOLATED` computers before use. The desktop is installed on first start. Stopping a computer saves its portable home and destroys the sandbox; the next start restores that home in a new sandbox. Railway sandbox usage is metered. New computers start in Railway's default region. Set `RAILWAY_SANDBOX_REGION` (for example `asia-southeast1-eqsg3a`) to keep them near the API; a running computer moves on its next start. Workspace exports reject files above 64 MiB without truncating them. Set `RAILWAY_MAX_WORKSPACE_FILE_BYTES` to change this limit. ## Desktop and mobile The Electron and Expo apps are clients of the same Rakazo API used by the web app. With the development stack running, launch Electron with: ```bash pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop dev ``` On first run the desktop app asks whether to run Rakazo on this computer or connect to an existing server. **This computer** installs and starts the published images with Docker Compose (the same files as `infra/compose/install-images.sh`) under the app's data directory, so Docker Desktop, OrbStack, or Docker Engine must be installed; the app links to them when it is not. Installed builds pin the image tag to their own version; unpackaged builds pull `edge`. Developers running `pnpm dev` should pick **Existing instance** with `http://127.0.0.1:5173` instead. Public servers must use HTTPS; HTTP is accepted only for loopback and private LAN addresses (not link-local). The app verifies Rakazo's health endpoint before saving, and later launches go straight to that instance. The stack keeps running after the app quits; **Stop Local Stack** in the application menu turns it off. On Linux the desktop app ships as an AppImage, which needs FUSE 2 (`libfuse.so.2`). Distributions that only include FUSE 3, such as Fedora Silverblue or Ubuntu 24.04, show `dlopen(): error loading libfuse.so.2`. Install the FUSE 2 library (`fuse-libs` on Fedora, `libfuse2t64` on Ubuntu 24.04, `libfuse2` on older Ubuntu and Debian), or run the AppImage without FUSE: ```bash chmod +x Rakazo-*.AppImage ./Rakazo-*.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run ``` **This computer** looks for the `docker` CLI and does not detect Podman. To try another Docker-compatible CLI that supports the `compose` commands, set `RAKAZO_DOCKER_BINARY` to its path before starting the app. Use **Change Rakazo Server…** in the application menu to reconnect. Closing that window without saving returns to the previous instance. For development automation, set `RAKAZO_WEB_URL` to point the shell somewhere else without changing the saved instance, or `RAKAZO_FORCE_SETUP=1` to run setup again. Mobile build and release instructions live in [docs/mobile-release.md](./docs/mobile-release.md). ## UI language The web (and Electron-hosted) UI supports English, Deutsch, 한국어, Türkçe, हिन्दी, Português (Brasil), 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Русский, Français, עברית, Nederlands, 日本語, and Polski under **Settings → Language**. The Expo app ships English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Русский, Deutsch, Nederlands, 日本語, Español, and Polski catalogs, and **Account → Language** lists all nine. A device language or `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_UI_LOCALE` still selects the starting catalog before a saved choice. Native Electron setup and menus also support the web UI's languages, following the saved app choice or, on first launch, the system language. The marketing homepage (`apps/www`) offers all 15 languages through footer links, including `/zh/` and `/zh-tw/`; other marketing pages remain primarily English. ## Development ```text apps/ web, api, worker, desktop, mobile, and public website packages/ domain, contracts, persistence, adapters, UI, and test tooling infra/ local services and computer images docs/ architecture, operations, and release guides ``` Common checks: ```bash pnpm lint pnpm check pnpm test pnpm test:integration pnpm test:e2e ``` See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for the development workflow and test matrix. ## Documentation Chinese guides cover [self-hosting](./docs/zh-CN/self-host.md), [models](./docs/zh-CN/self-host-models.md), [backups](./docs/zh-CN/self-host-backups.md), [upgrading](./docs/zh-CN/self-host-upgrading.md), and [restricted networks](./docs/zh-CN/self-host-restricted-network.md). - [Self-hosting](./docs/self-host.md) - [Self-host configuration](./docs/self-host-configuration.md) - [Self-host secrets](./docs/self-host-secrets.md) - [Sign-in and accounts](./docs/self-host-accounts.md) - [Models](./docs/self-host-models.md) - [Tools and integrations](./docs/self-host-integrations.md) - [Computer providers](./docs/self-host-sandbox-providers.md) - [Docker computers](./docs/self-host-docker-computers.md) - [Storage and encryption](./docs/self-host-storage.md) - [Production deployment](./docs/self-host-production.md) - [Backup and restore](./docs/self-host-backups.md) - [Upgrading](./docs/self-host-upgrading.md) - [Logs and monitoring](./docs/self-host-observability.md) - [Audit log](./docs/self-host-audit-log.md) - [Apps and clients](./docs/self-host-clients.md) - [Billing](./docs/self-host-billing.md) - [Computer runtime and isolation](./docs/computer-runtime.md) - [Desktop releases](./docs/desktop-release.md) - [Mobile releases](./docs/mobile-release.md) - [Performance testing](./docs/performance.md) - [Bots that manage bots](./docs/fleet-management.md) ## How Rakazo compares - [Grok Bot](https://rakazo.com/grok-bot-alternative/) - [Muse](https://rakazo.com/muse-alternative/) - [Dots](https://rakazo.com/dots-alternative/) - [Instinct](https://rakazo.com/instinct-alternative/) - [OpenClaw](https://rakazo.com/openclaw-alternative/) - [Hermes Agent](https://rakazo.com/hermes-alternative/) - [All comparisons](https://rakazo.com/alternatives/) ## Thanks - [Inbox Zero](https://getinboxzero.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) - [PromptLayer](https://promptlayer.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) - [ConnectorMap](https://connectormap.luinbytes.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) - [CodeRabbit](https://www.coderabbit.ai/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) - [Greptile](https://www.greptile.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) - [Snyk](https://snyk.io/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) - [Incredibuild](https://www.incredibuild.com/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=rakazo_readme) ## Stack - TypeScript - React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS - Electron and Expo - Hono and oRPC - PostgreSQL and Prisma - Better Auth - Graphile Worker - Pi - Docker, E2B, Daytona, CreateOS, and Boat - Composio, Pipedream Connect, MCP, and OpenAPI integrations ## Contributing Contributions are welcome. Please read [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. For security vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) instead of filing a public issue. Rakazo is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](./LICENSE). Questions and ideas are welcome in the [Rakazo Discord community](https://discord.gg/RWwKa2Sn7h).

# Rakazo [English](./README.md) | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [日本語](./README.ja.md) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/elie222/rakazo?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&color=2563EB)](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/stargazers) [![加入 Discord 社区](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20the%20community-5865F2?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/RWwKa2Sn7h) [![在 App Store 下载 iPhone 版](https://img.shields.io/badge/App%20Store-Download%20for%20iPhone-black?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=apple&logoColor=white)](https://apps.apple.com/app/rakazo/id6801531099) [![在 Google Play 下载 Android 版](https://img.shields.io/badge/Google%20Play-Get%20the%20app-black?labelColor=black&style=for-the-badge&logo=googleplay&logoColor=white)](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rakazo.app) ![Rakazo：由你掌控的 AI 队友](./docs/readme-hero.png) Rakazo 是 Grok Bot 的开源、自托管替代方案。 长期在线的 AI 队友，各自拥有记忆、例行任务、应用和计算机。在自己的机器上运行，使用自己的模型。 可在[网页](https://app.rakazo.com)、[桌面端](https://rakazo.com/download/)、[iPhone](https://apps.apple.com/app/rakazo/id6801531099) 和 [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rakazo.app) 上使用。 它也是 Meta Muse、OpenAI Dots、Instinct、OpenClaw、Hermes Agent、Claude Duet 和 Hark Pro 的替代方案。 详情见 [rakazo.com](https://rakazo.com)。 本文是 [英文 README](./README.md) 的简体中文译文。[自托管指南](./docs/zh-CN/self-host.md)已提供中文。 ## 功能 - 例行任务 - 记忆 - 使用计算机和浏览器 - 私有或共享的团队计算机 - 在 Docker、云端或自己的机器上运行沙箱 - 群聊 - 任务委派与子智能体 - 构建可通过链接分享的仪表盘和文档 - 语音聊天和通话 - 任意模型，使用自己的密钥 - 数千个应用集成，并支持 MCP
### 每个机器人都有一台计算机 浏览器、终端、文件和完整桌面。看着它工作，需要登录时接管，再交还给它。 ### 协同工作的机器人 把机器人拉进群聊并 @ 它们。它们分工合作、互相检查，再向你汇报。
### 例行任务 按计划、收到邮件或 Webhook 时运行机器人，并查看每一次运行。 ### 页面 机器人构建实时仪表盘和文档，可全屏打开、分享，并就其提问。
### 连接应用 Gmail、Slack、GitHub、Notion、Linear 等数千个应用，以及你自己的 MCP 服务器和 OpenAPI 工具。 ### 全平台可用 网页、桌面端、iPhone 和 Android，连接同一台服务器。
## 部署到 Railway [![部署到 Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/new/template/rakazo-template) 部署包含 PostgreSQL、持久化存储和 Railway 计算机的私有 Rakazo 实例。 填写邮箱和 Railway API 令牌，登录后再连接模型。 参见[安装、安全默认设置与备份](./infra/railway/README.md)。 ## 快速开始（已发布镜像） 需要 Docker Engine、Compose 插件、curl 和 OpenSSL。无需克隆仓库或安装 Node.js。 ```bash mkdir -p rakazo && cd rakazo && curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/elie222/rakazo/main/infra/compose/install-images.sh && bash install-images.sh ``` 安装脚本会下载 Compose 文件，生成包含随机密钥的 `.env`，并启动 Rakazo。 再次运行时会保留已有的 `.env`。 打开 [http://127.0.0.1:5173](http://127.0.0.1:5173)，创建账号并连接模型。 默认启用本地 Docker 计算机。远程计算机所需的凭据、模板和准备步骤见[计算机提供商（英文）](./docs/self-host-sandbox-providers.md)。 默认镜像标签为 `edge`，由主分支构建，支持 `linux/amd64` 和 `linux/arm64`。 镜像详情与标签见[自托管指南](./docs/zh-CN/self-host.md#已发布镜像无需检出源码)。 在受限网络中，可以覆盖安装器的下载地址前缀（`RAKAZO_DOWNLOAD_BASE`），跳过已有的 Compose 文件 （`--local` / `RAKAZO_DOWNLOAD_SKIP_EXISTING`），或使用引导脚本的镜像地址。 参见[受限网络与镜像下载](./docs/zh-CN/self-host-restricted-network.md)。 如需让智能体协助安装，请使用 [SETUP_PROMPT.md](./SETUP_PROMPT.md)。 ## 在服务器上运行 后端在服务器上运行时，机器人可以持续在线。在 VPS 上使用同一个安装脚本， 然后通过桌面应用、移动应用或浏览器连接。 ```bash bash install-images.sh --prepare-only # edit .env: SANDBOX_PROVIDER=boat (or e2b / daytona / createos) with its API key, RAKAZO_HOST=your.domain bash install-images.sh ``` 为 5173 端口配置 HTTPS 入口。[docs/self-host-production.md](./docs/self-host-production.md#public-single-vm-deployment) 介绍了 Caddy 配置和主机加固方法。在桌面应用中选择 **Existing instance**（已有实例），填写 `https://` 地址。 ## 本地开发（从源码运行） 需要 Node.js 24.x（至少 24.15.0）或 Node.js 26 及以上版本，以及 pnpm 12 和 Docker。 不支持 Node.js 25.x。 ```bash git clone https://github.com/elie222/rakazo.git cd rakazo cp .env.example .env ``` 将 `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` 和 `POSTGRES_APP_PASSWORD` 分别设置为由 `openssl rand -hex 16` 生成的两个值，再把它们填入 `DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL` 和 `DATABASE_URL`。 应用以自己的 `rakazo_app` 登录身份连接数据库，并受行级安全策略约束；迁移则以所有者身份运行（参见 [数据库角色](docs/self-host-configuration.md#database-roles)）。 为 `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`、`ENCRYPTION_KEY` 和 `SCREEN_PROXY_SECRET` 分别设置独立的长随机值。 Docker 沙箱还需要专用的 `SANDBOX_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN`。 你也可以设置 `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`，或在首次设置时连接支持的模型提供商。 使用 Docker Desktop 在宿主机上开发时，在 `.env` 中设置 `SANDBOX_CONTROL_VIA_LOOPBACK=true`。 沙箱监督服务会自动发现 Docker Desktop 的用户套接字；使用其他 Docker 运行环境时， 可以通过 `DOCKER_HOST` 或 `DOCKER_SOCKET` 覆盖该设置。 托管应用目录是可选功能。使用 Composio 时设置 `COMPOSIO_API_KEY`； 使用 Pipedream Connect 时设置 `PIPEDREAM_CLIENT_ID`、`PIPEDREAM_CLIENT_SECRET` 和 `PIPEDREAM_PROJECT_ID`。 即使不启用这两个托管目录，用户也可以在 **Integrations**（集成）中添加 HTTPS MCP 服务器或 OpenAPI JSON 文档。连接器凭据在服务器上加密存储，API 不会返回这些凭据。 付费数据服务（地图地点、搜索结果、工作邮箱、个人资料、SEO 数据）同样是可选的。 设置 `PAID_SERVICES_PROVIDER=treg`，并在 `PAID_SERVICES_API_KEY` 中填入组织级 [Treg](https://treg.to) 令牌， 机器人即可使用部署方的账户查找并调用这些服务。启用模型额度时，每次调用按服务商成本加 20% 从组织的额度中扣除。 ```bash pnpm install pnpm sandbox:build pnpm dev ``` `pnpm dev` 会使用 `DATABASE_URL` 指向且可连接的 Postgres；否则会通过 Docker 启动本地 `rakazo-dev-postgres` 容器，所有检出目录共用该容器。启动服务前会应用数据库迁移并生成 Prisma 客户端。 如果当前分支新增了 `main` 尚未包含的迁移，会在同一服务器上使用独立数据库，条件允许时从共享数据库复制， 避免未合入的数据库结构变更影响共享数据库。默认端口被占用时（例如另一个 Git worktree 正在运行）， 会选择下一个空闲端口组并打印访问地址。 如需改用 Compose 中的 Postgres，可通过 `postgres-host` 叠加配置启动，将端口发布到回环地址 `127.0.0.1:5433`，并让 `DATABASE_URL` 和 `DATABASE_MIGRATION_URL` 指向它： ```bash docker compose --env-file .env \ -f infra/compose/docker-compose.yml \ -f infra/compose/docker-compose.postgres-host.yml \ up postgres -d ``` `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` 应使用无需 URI 转义的字符，例如通过 `openssl rand -hex 16` 生成。 已有的 `pgdata` 数据卷会保留首次初始化时的用户、密码和数据库， 因此应保留 `.env` 中相应的值，或使用 `ALTER ROLE`、重命名等方式在数据库中修改。 只有在完成备份后，或确认数据可以丢弃时，才重建数据卷；`docker compose down -v` 会删除全部 Postgres 数据。 打开终端打印的地址（默认是 [http://127.0.0.1:5173](http://127.0.0.1:5173)），创建账号、连接模型，并创建第一个机器人。 部署、提供商选择、备份与升级说明见[自托管指南](./docs/zh-CN/self-host.md)。 使用 CreateOS 时，设置 `SANDBOX_PROVIDER=createos` 和 `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_API_KEY`。 可选配置 `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_BASE_URL`、`CREATEOS_SANDBOX_SHAPE` 和 `CREATEOS_SANDBOX_ROOTFS` 的默认值分别为 `https://api.sb.createos.sh`、`s-2vcpu-2gb` 和 `desktop:1`。 使用 Railway 计算机时，在 API 和 worker 上设置 `SANDBOX_PROVIDER=railway`、`RAILWAY_API_TOKEN` 和 `RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID`。请显式选择沙箱环境；Railway 自动注入的环境 ID 对应的是托管应用所在的环境。 使用能完成所需操作的最小权限 Railway API 令牌：若项目令牌满足沙箱操作要求且客户端认证支持，则优先使用项目令牌。 当前提供商使用 Bearer 认证，因此应使用团队或工作区令牌，而非个人账号令牌。 实时屏幕和桌面需要 `PRIVATE` 网络模式，才能通过 Railway 公共域名提供屏幕访问。 计算机采用此模式，可以访问同一 Railway 项目和环境中的其他服务，也可以访问公网。 建议为沙箱使用专用 Railway 项目，或至少使用独立环境，与应用和数据库分开。 已有的 `ISOLATED` 计算机需要重建后再使用。 桌面环境会在首次启动时安装。停止计算机会保存可迁移的主目录并销毁沙箱；下次启动时，在新沙箱中恢复该主目录。 Railway 沙箱按用量计费。 新建计算机使用 Railway 的默认区域。可设置 `RAILWAY_SANDBOX_REGION`（例如 `asia-southeast1-eqsg3a`）， 使其更靠近 API；已运行的计算机会在下次启动时迁移。 工作区导出会拒绝超过 64 MiB 的文件，不会截断文件内容。可通过 `RAILWAY_MAX_WORKSPACE_FILE_BYTES` 修改此限制。 ## 桌面端与移动端 Electron 和 Expo 应用都是 Rakazo API 的客户端，与网页版使用同一套 API。 开发服务启动后，使用以下命令启动 Electron： ```bash pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop dev ``` 首次运行时，桌面应用会询问是在本机运行 Rakazo，还是连接已有服务器。 选择 **This computer**（本机）会在应用数据目录中，通过 Docker Compose 安装并启动已发布镜像， 使用的文件与 `infra/compose/install-images.sh` 相同。 因此需要先安装 Docker Desktop、OrbStack 或 Docker Engine；未安装时，应用会提供相应链接。 已安装的发行版将镜像标签固定为自身版本，未打包的开发版本则拉取 `edge`。 运行 `pnpm dev` 的开发者应选择 **Existing instance**（已有实例），地址填写终端打印的地址（默认为 `http://127.0.0.1:5173`）。 公共服务器必须使用 HTTPS；只有回环地址和局域网私有地址允许 HTTP，不包括链路本地地址。 应用会在保存地址前检查 Rakazo 的健康检查端点，之后启动时直接连接该实例。 退出应用后，服务仍会继续运行；可通过应用菜单中的 **Stop Local Stack**（停止本地服务）将其关闭。 在 Linux 上，桌面应用以 AppImage 形式发布，需要 FUSE 2（`libfuse.so.2`）。只包含 FUSE 3 的发行版（例如 Fedora Silverblue 或 Ubuntu 24.04）会报错 `dlopen(): error loading libfuse.so.2`。请安装 FUSE 2 库（Fedora 上为 `fuse-libs`，Ubuntu 24.04 上为 `libfuse2t64`，较早的 Ubuntu 和 Debian 上为 `libfuse2`），或者不借助 FUSE 运行 AppImage： ```bash chmod +x Rakazo-*.AppImage ./Rakazo-*.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run ``` 使用应用菜单中的 **Change Rakazo Server…**（更换 Rakazo 服务器）重新选择服务器。 关闭该窗口且不保存时，会返回之前的实例。 开发自动化中，可以设置 `RAKAZO_WEB_URL`，让桌面应用连接其他地址而不改变已保存的实例； 也可以设置 `RAKAZO_FORCE_SETUP=1`，再次运行设置流程。 移动端构建和发布说明见 [docs/mobile-release.md](./docs/mobile-release.md)。 ## 界面语言 网页版及 Electron 内嵌界面可在 **Settings → Language**（设置 → 语言）中选择英语、德语、韩语、土耳其语、 印地语、巴西葡萄牙语、简体中文、繁体中文、西班牙语、俄语、法语、希伯来语、荷兰语、日语和波兰语。 Expo 应用包含英语、简体中文、繁体中文、俄语、德语、荷兰语、日语、西班牙语和波兰语翻译，**Account → Language**（账号 → 语言）列出这九种语言。 在用户保存选择之前，移动端的初始语言由设备语言或 `EXPO_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_UI_LOCALE` 决定。 Electron 原生设置窗口和菜单也支持上述网页版语言，并跟随应用中保存的选择；首次启动使用系统语言。 官网首页（`apps/www`）可通过页脚切换全部 15 种语言，简体中文路径为 `/zh/`，繁体中文为 `/zh-tw/`。 其他官网页面主要仍为英文。 ## 开发 ```text apps/
